title: Survey builder
goal: Turn the page into a survey tool with two views. The list view has a text input with the placeholder "Question", a button labelled "Create survey", and the stored surveys, each shown as "QUESTION (draft)" before it is published or "QUESTION (N responses)" after, with a button labelled "Open QUESTION". Opening a survey replaces the list with the survey view: the question, a button labelled "Back" to the list, and each choice as "CHOICE: N (P%)", where N is its number of answers and P its share of all answers, rounded to a whole number (0 when there are none), followed by "Responses: N". While the survey is a draft, the view also has a text input with the placeholder "Option", a button labelled "Add option" and a button labelled "Publish". Once published, these are gone and each choice has a button labelled "Answer CHOICE" that records one answer. The server refuses to add options to a published survey and to record answers on a draft, also when asked directly. Surveys are stored as `Survey` nodes connected to root, with fields `question: str` and `published: bool`; each choice is a `Choice` node with fields `label: str` and `votes: int`, connected to its survey, not to root. Every change is stored on the server and shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
